note: B34-DEF-002. Records, per platform, which of app.json/app.config vs the checked-in native project actually drives the shipped artifact -- so nobody has to guess, and so a parity gate can enforce it.

android.reason: android/ is committed to this repository (git ls-files android/ returns tracked files) and carries Build 32's release-critical R8/minification and AAB configuration directly in native Gradle files. app.json's `android` block is not what produces the shipped artifact -- android/app/build.gradle and android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml are. app.json is required to stay in sync with them; it does not drive them.

buildProfileManifestExceptions.note: Build 34 Android staging certification, extended by Android Repair 07. Android is NATIVE_AUTHORITATIVE, so app.json cannot express a permission that exists in ONE build configuration only. This block is the governed declaration of every such exception: what the exception is, which manifest carries it, which selector turns it on, and what it may never contain. check-native-config-parity.js enforces it. Anything not listed here is NOT an approved exception -- an extra granted permission in an exception manifest fails the gate, and an exception manifest that exists under android/app/src without a declaration here fails it too. Repair 07 made Voice and remote push INDEPENDENT native capabilities: because an Android build-type source set has exactly one manifest slot, the four on/off combinations are carried by four manifests (src/release, src/certification, src/push, src/voicePush) selected in android/app/build.gradle by voiceNativeCapabilityMaterialized and pushNativeCapabilityMaterialized. Neither boolean is ever derived from the other, from EAS_BUILD_PROFILE, or from the presence of GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON.

exceptions.reason: Voice Scan V1 (converged from PR #218) needs RECORD_AUDIO to run Android on-device speech recognition. It is enabled for the staging-certification AAB only. Adding it to app.json + src/main would broaden the PRODUCTION artifact before Voice Scan is formally promoted, so the grant lives in a build-type manifest the selector chooses instead.
exceptions.defaultArtifactPosture: RECORD_AUDIO stays tools:node="remove" in android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml and stays in app.json android.blockedPermissions, so production and every non-certification profile request no microphone permission at all.
exceptions.artifactVerificationRequired: Manifest-merger behaviour is not provable from source. The merged manifest of the built certification AAB must be inspected before certification, and the merged manifest of a production AAB must be inspected to prove RECORD_AUDIO is still absent.

exceptions.reason: ANDROID-VOICE-01. A future, separately authorized production Voice Scan build needs the identical RECORD_AUDIO grant staging-certification already proves, without requiring another source-code repair to get it. This reaches the SAME manifest and SAME permission as VOICE_SCAN_CERTIFICATION_MICROPHONE above, through a second, non-public, generic native selector (KSCAN_VOICE_NATIVE_CAPABILITY) instead of the certification-only one -- so KSCAN_VOICE_CERTIFICATION keeps meaning exactly what it always meant (this is the staging-certification build) and is never silently reinterpreted to also mean 'production has Voice'.
exceptions.defaultArtifactPosture: RECORD_AUDIO stays tools:node="remove" in android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml and stays in app.json android.blockedPermissions. selectorSetByEasProfiles is deliberately empty: eas.json commits this selector to NO profile today, including production -- it is supplied out of band by the governed production release environment only at the moment of an explicitly authorized activation (see docs/build34-android-voice-production-readiness-runbook.md). Committing it to any profile's eas.json env would itself broaden that profile before authorization, which is exactly what this declaration must not do.
exceptions.artifactVerificationRequired: Manifest-merger behaviour is not provable from source. Before any production Voice release, the merged manifest of a production AAB built WITH KSCAN_VOICE_NATIVE_CAPABILITY=true set must be inspected to prove RECORD_AUDIO is present, and the merged manifest of an ordinary production AAB (selector unset, today's shipping state) must be inspected to prove it is still absent.

exceptions.reason: Android Repair 07. Ordinary production ships no remote-push consumer -- Repairs 05 and 06 made the runtime inert (no permission request, no Expo push token, no device registration) -- so android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml now removes POST_NOTIFICATIONS by default. That removal is what neutralises expo-notifications' OWN library manifest, which declares the permission independently of K Scan; deleting K Scan's line alone would have left it in the merged manifest. A build that genuinely activates remote push re-grants it here. Repair 05 recorded this static-permission separation as future debt precisely because the four-state native architecture did not exist yet; this exception is that debt closed. This exception covers the push-ON / Voice-OFF combination.
exceptions.defaultArtifactPosture: POST_NOTIFICATIONS is tools:node="remove" in android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml and is listed in app.json android.blockedPermissions, so ordinary production, staging, preview, development and any local `gradlew bundleRelease` declare no notification permission at all. The grant appears only in a build whose pushNativeCapabilityMaterialized resolves true, which is the same EXPO_PUBLIC_SMART_WATCHLIST_V1 input Repair 05 uses for runtime activation and for the fail-closed FCM requirement -- so a push-capable artifact cannot be produced without GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON, and the presence of that credential alone never grants the permission.
exceptions.artifactVerificationRequired: Manifest-merger behaviour is not provable from source. The merged manifest of an ordinary production AAB must be inspected to prove POST_NOTIFICATIONS is ABSENT despite expo-notifications contributing it, and the merged manifest of a push-capable AAB (EXPO_PUBLIC_SMART_WATCHLIST_V1=true) must be inspected to prove it is PRESENT.

exceptions.reason: Android Repair 07. An Android build-type source set has exactly ONE manifest slot, so Voice and remote push -- which are independent capabilities that may each be on or off -- need a manifest per combination. This is the both-ON file. Its content is nothing beyond src/certification's Voice block plus src/push's push grant over the same src/release base; it introduces no policy of its own. staging-certification is the profile that enables both today (EXPO_PUBLIC_SMART_WATCHLIST_V1 and KSCAN_VOICE_CERTIFICATION), but that is a fact about one profile, not a coupling: the three sibling manifests are what prove either capability can ship without the other.
exceptions.defaultArtifactPosture: Selected only when BOTH pushNativeCapabilityMaterialized and voiceNativeCapabilityMaterialized resolve true. Both POST_NOTIFICATIONS and RECORD_AUDIO stay tools:node="remove" in android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml and stay in app.json android.blockedPermissions, so the default artifact declares neither.
exceptions.artifactVerificationRequired: The merged manifest of a staging-certification AAB must be inspected to prove BOTH POST_NOTIFICATIONS and RECORD_AUDIO are present, and that MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS still arrives through expo-audio's ordinary merge (Repair 03) while FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE and CAPTURE_AUDIO_OUTPUT remain absent.

ios.reason: No ios/ directory is committed to this repository (git ls-files ios/ returns zero files, and it is absent from .gitignore -- it is simply never generated into source control). Build 33's App Review hardening (routing/location/microphone-absence, associated domains, privacy manifest entries) lives entirely as declarative fields under app.json's `ios` block, which Expo's Continuous Native Generation (CNG) expands into a fresh Info.plist/Xcode project at prebuild/build time. app.json IS the sole source of truth for iOS; there is no native file to fall out of sync with.

crossPlatformInvariants.note: Fields that must agree across both platforms even though the platforms use different authority models.
